02 /Retrieval & knowledge systems

Finding the right context.

A retrieval pipeline that combines lexical and semantic signals, then refines the results before they become useful context.

Code↗How it works↓
02

Project focus

The retrieval layer behind knowledge-driven applications: query processing, candidate fusion, and relevance ranking.

  • BGE-M3
  • Milvus
  • Flask
  • React
  • Reranking
01

The problem

Keyword matching can miss related meaning; semantic search can overlook exact terms. Combining the two gives a query more ways to find relevant passages, while reranking helps select the strongest candidates.

02

How it comes together

  1. 01

    Expand

    LLM-assisted query expansion adds related context to the input.

  2. 02

    Embed

    BGE-M3 produces sparse and dense query representations.

  3. 03

    Retrieve

    Milvus combines both searches with reciprocal rank fusion.

  4. 04

    Rerank

    A BGE reranker refines the retrieved passages before returning results.

My contribution

  • Integrated BGE-M3 embeddings and Milvus hybrid search into a single retrieval path.
  • Combined query expansion, candidate fusion, and optional reranking behind a Flask API.
  • Made the search pipeline accessible from a web interface, with configurable retrieval and ranking components.
03

The result

A searchable prototype for comparing and combining lexical and semantic retrieval. Its public implementation makes the route from a user query to ranked passages explicit—the context-retrieval foundation for a RAG system.
